theorems.statement: For the integer critical-degeneracy matrix K, expanding K_ij into K_ij parallel critical dominant branch symbols gives a finite multigraph with (K^n)_ij equal to the exact length-n critical dominant branch-word count from i to j. With B_n=1^T K^n 1 and T_n=tr(K^n), Gamma_crit=ln rho(K)=lim_n (1/n)ln B_n. B_n and T_n obey exact integer Cayley-Hamilton recurrences and -z p_K'(z)/p_K(z)=sum_{n>=1}T_n z^n.
theorems.gauge: Positive rational vertex gauge leaves dominant ties and all critical cycle products unchanged, hence K'=K exactly and all K-derived observables are exact gauge invariants.
theorems.zero_law: Gamma_crit=0 iff the recurrent critical automaton is a disjoint union of unit-multiplicity directed cycles, equivalently B_n is bounded/constant on the recurrent-state carrier.

theorems.statement: Let P_n be the number of primitive periodic edge-labeled critical branch orbits of exact length n in the expanded K-multigraph. Then T_n=sum_{d|n} d P_d, so P_n=(1/n)sum_{d|n} mu(d)T_{n/d} is a non-negative integer. The critical multiplicity zeta satisfies the exact formal Euler product 1/det(I-zK)=product_{n>=1}(1-z^n)^(-P_n).
theorems.finite_representation: Every coefficient through order N depends only on P_1..P_N; the entire infinite primitive inventory is finitely encoded by the integer polynomial p_K(z)=det(I-zK).
theorems.gauge: Since rational vertex gauge leaves K exactly unchanged, every P_n and the entire Euler product are exact gauge invariants.

negative_boundaries.statement: WBRC-T44 primitive periodic edge-word orbits are not WBRC-T29 Möbius-primitive simple support circuits. T29 is finite feedback-event-subset semantics; T44 is arbitrary-length periodic-word semantics in the condensed critical automaton.

The term residual/topological entropy denotes the classical logarithmic word-growth rate ln rho(K). No Shannon probability distribution, information entropy, Fisher metric or stochastic interpretation is implied.

The P_n are primitive periodic orbit counts, not arithmetic prime counts. The Euler product is the classical dynamical-zeta factorization and is not an arithmetic-prime Euler product or a generic novelty claim.
